description: Apache Tomcat config audit — Offline security review of Apache Tomcat configuration: server.xml, tomcat-users.xml, web.xml and context.xml (send one or several concatenated). Flags AJP Ghostcat exposure (secretRequired=false, no secret, all-interface bind), plaintext HTTP connectors, obsolete TLS protocols and weak ciphers, default SHUTDOWN port, TRACE, X-Powered-By, autoDeploy, missing ErrorReportValve/AccessLogValve/LockOutRealm, default or empty manager passwords and plaintext users, manager-script roles, open RemoteAddrValve, writable DefaultServlet (PUT upload), directory listings, cookie flags and missing HttpHeaderSecurityFilter. Returns verdict PASS/PASS_WITH_WARNINGS/REVIEW/FAIL, score, grade A-F, findings with line numbers and fixes. Passwords are never echoed. Params: text= the XML, or url= a raw file URL (GitHub blob links are converted). Price: $0.005 USDC (Base, via x402).

text.description: e.g. <Server port='8005' shutdown='SHUTDOWN'><Service name='Catalina'><Connector protocol='AJP/1.3' address='0.0.0.0' port='8009' secretRequired='false'/></Service></Server>

name: security_tomcat_check
